## POST `/performance/Array/backup`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

"Run Now Backup of SPA database for passed in symmId using specified filename\n saved as ({symmID}_YYYYMMDDHHmm_GMT_{filename}_SPABackup.dat)\n e.g.opt\\jboss\\backup\\SPA\\000197900256_201908231102_GMT_Laptop_SPABackup.dat\n \nHistorical data is backed up by default.\n\nLast day of diagnostic (True or False) added to backup if true.\n\nNamed Real Time Traces is optional (True or False) added to backup if true.\n"

**Request body** (required): `arrayBackupParam`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `symmetrixId` | string | The local Symmetrix array ID. |
| `filename` | string | Filename saved as ({symmID}_YYYYMMDDHHmm_GMT_{filename}_SPABackup.dat) |
| `lastdayofdiagnostic` | boolean | True means Backup last day of diagnostic data(5 mins intervals) |
| `namedrealtimetraces` | boolean | True means Backup Named Real Time Traces.) |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `arrayBackupResult` · `202` Accepted · `400` Bad Request · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `409` Conflict · `500` Internal Server Error

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)

## PUT `/performance/threshold/update/{category}`

**Tier:** T2 (T3 if it destroys, eradicates, disables or overwrites)  

Edit an existing Global Threshold across all systems. In order for this feature to work email needs to be setup. Set includeRealTimeTraceOnCritical to true to trigger RT Trace

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `category` | path | string | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `editPerformanceThresholdParam`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `metric` | string | SPA Metric Name. |
| `firstThreshold` | number (float) | First Threshold must be less than second threshold. Deprecated: Please use new parameters lowerWarning, upperWarning, lowerError and upperError |
| `secondThreshold` | number (float) | Second Threshold must be greater than 1st threshold. Deprecated: Please use new parameters lowerWarning, upperWarning, lowerError and upperError |
| `firstLowerThreshold` | number (float) | First Lower Threshold must be greater than second Lower threshold. |
| `firstUpperThreshold` | number (float) | First Upper Threshold must be less than second Upper threshold. |
| `secondLowerThreshold` | number (float) | Second Lower Threshold must be less than 1st Lower threshold. |
| `secondUpperThreshold` | number (float) | Second Upper Threshold must be greater than 1st Upperthreshold. |
| `alert` | boolean | Alert On/Off. True to enable , False to disable. |
| `firstThresholdOccurrrences` | integer (int32) | Error occurrences . Number between 1 and 999 and less than samples. |
| `firstThresholdSamples` | integer (int32) | Error Samples. Number between 1 and 999 and greater than occurrences. |
| `firstThresholdSeverity` | string (enum: `INFORMATION`, `WARNING`, `CRITICAL`) | Error Severity . Must be one of the following values. INFORMATION WARNING CRITICAL Enumeration values: * **INFORMATION** * **WARNING** * **CRITICAL** |
| `secondThresholdOccurrrences` | integer (int32) | Warning occurrences. Number between 1 and 999 and less than samples. |
| `secondThresholdSamples` | integer (int32) | Warning Samples. Number between 1 and 999 and greater than occurrences. |
| `secondThresholdSeverity` | string (enum: `INFORMATION`, `WARNING`, `CRITICAL`) | Warning Severity. Must be one of the following values. INFORMATION WARNING CRITICAL Enumeration values: * **INFORMATION** * **WARNING** * **CRITICAL** |
| `includeRealTimeTraceOnCritical` | boolean | Include Real Time trace on critical alert On/Off. True to enable , False to disable. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `genericResult` · `202` Accepted · `400` Bad Request · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `409` Conflict · `500` Internal Server Error
